capabilities: : Display search results in a popup
: Filter search scope by folder and extension
extras: This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
intentEvidence: Fuzzy search a note or a whole vault with an AI decision model — no exact word matching, no search engine to set up.
problem: Traditional search methods often fail to find relevant information when exact keywords are not used or when the search index is not set up.

relations.evidence: The default preset targets Jev (TypeSafe's decision model)
Any endpoint speaking the same protocol works through the Custom preset.

summary: AI decision model that performs fuzzy search across notes or an entire vault without requiring exact keyword matching or a traditional search engine setup.
